messages:
Maya L.: flagging a mobile issue from QA: invoice download CTA gets pushed below the fold. users miss it. need layout decision.

Josh K.: saw it. current mobile stack = chart -> tokens -> actions. people expect invoice/download near top.

Elaine (Design): posted two quick mocks: https://redwood.design/mockups/spend-compact-cta
Option 1: pin CTA under scope toggle in top header.
Option 2: floating FAB bottom-right on small screens.

Samir: prefer pinned header for discoverability, but use an outline style and clear copy: "Download invoices".

Oliver P.: product ask: CTA copy should reflect scope (org vs project). add telemetry for clicks and scope context.

Elaine (Design): accessibility: aria-label must include scope and name, e.g. "Download invoices for Acme Corp (org)". visible focus ring required.

Maya L.: tokens feedback: bubble chart is noisy on narrow widths. proposal: compact chips (top 3 visible) with an expand toggle to bubble chart.

Josh K.: agree. default compact view on mobile, bubble on desktop.

Samir: ensure chips are keyboard-focusable and show hover/keyboard expansion. top-3 visible when collapsed.

design-bot: attachment: screenshot-2060012345-v1.png uploaded.

Oliver P.: scope toggle placement: analytics show top toolbar used more. put scope next to CTA.

Maya L.: keep top toolbar single-line on mobile. ellipsis project name and a kebab for extra actions to avoid stacking.

Josh K.: impl note: header should be position:sticky; fallback to FAB if not supported. I'll open an RFC PR and wire telemetry.

Samir: A/B plan: A = pinned header CTA + compact tokens default; B = FAB + bubble default. track invoice-download, token-expand, scope-switch.

Elaine (Design): updating Figma with chips, focus states, and CTA variants. tagging @engineering-design for accessibility review.

Oliver P.: I'll provision experiment in LaunchDarkly and share the doc. :thumbsup:

Samir: small accessibility add: invoice filename should include org/project and ISO date for clarity when listed/downloaded.

Elaine (Design): noted, adding to spec.

Maya L.: timeline: PR for header changes next sprint?

Josh K.: yes, will take it. linking tickets when PR is ready.

Maya L.: great, closing once mocks + PRs are in.
